details.jobDescription:
We’re looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in credit risk analysis, modelling or reporting;

  • Strong SQL and Python skills (experience with additional tools is a plus);

  • Proven experience in banks or fintech companies is required;

  • Expertise in credit risk analysis, scoring models, PD/LGD/EAD modelling, and portfolio performance metrics;

  • Hands-on mindset: comfortable working deeply with data, validating outputs, and troubleshooting end-to-end processes;

  • The ability to present analysis results to people without advanced statistical knowledge.

  • English B2+

Your mission as Data Scientist (Credit Risk):

  • Build and optimise scoring models and risk segmentation strategies;

  • Analyse portfolio performance and identify risk drivers;

  • Providing advanced analytical support for ad-hoc tasks

  • Support credit risk decision-making with data-driven insights;

  • Effective cooperation with business areas: IT, marketing, debt collection, customer support.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package;

  • Opportunity to work closely with international leadership;

  • Professional growth within a fast-growing global FinTech company.

  • A top health insurance

  • Meal tickets
